title: Decision
description: A choice made by the agent or the system at a fork. First-class artifact per docs/architecture.md invariant 1 and the AI-output-validation pattern in docs/evidence-model.md.

why.description: Reasoning, in the agent's own words.

evidence_refs.description: Event/Trace/Validation ids that justify this decision.

validated.description: false until at least one Validation entity has evaluated this Decision. AI proposals MUST start false (see AI output validation pattern).

root_cause.description: Set true only after Validation confirms this was the first invalid decision/state in the debugging chain.
